plainText:
Nemona (Japanese: ネモ Nemo) is a supporting character in . She is a -ranked who first appeared in Nemona and Brassius and.... 

Nemona is also the current student council president of Naranja Academy and eventually became a friendly rival to Roy, often challenging him to battle.

==In animation==
===History===
====Pre-series====
Prior to the events of the series, Nemona challenged the Paldea League and managed to become a -ranked Trainer. This made her famous among Trainers in the Paldea region.

====Pokémon Horizons: The Series====
 and Roy]]
Nemona first appeared in Nemona and Brassius and... while winning a battle against a Trainer. Some time before meeting Liko and Roy, Nemona came to Artazon town to meet with Brassius and discuss his absence from the Gym. Upon being introduced to the young Trainers, Nemona joined them to go to the Gym and meet Brassius. During the meeting, they discussed their works and when Roy spoke about the Black Rayquaza, Brassius kicked everyone out of his house. While discussing why Brassius acted the way he did, Liko came to the conclusion that Brassius might have . After that, Nemona took Liko and Roy to the and decided to group as many to create inspiration for Brassius again, showing them later that she managed to gather fifteen species. After Brassius saw the group's determination and his 's insistence, Brassius presented Nemona, Liko and Roy with a work based on his vision of . As soon as Brassius challenged Roy to a , Nemona watched the battle along with Liko and explained some concepts like stallization to her. At the end, Brassius presented another work of his to the group, one based on the forest's .
 ]]
In the next episode, Nemona accompanied Liko, Roy, and Mollie into the Arboliva's Forest. Upon arriving, Nemona said goodbye to the group and said that the next time she would met them, she would like to have a battle with Roy.

Nemona appeared in a flashback to Liko and Roy's journey in From So Far Away.

In Welcome to Naranja Academy!, Nemona reunited with Liko and Roy and met Dot after they enrolled at Naranja Academy to train for the Tera Training. During the reunion, Liko and Roy discovered that Nemona's Pawmo evolved, and shortly thereafter, Nemona challenged Roy to a battle but was stopped by Clavell. Shortly after, Nemona showed off the Academy to the freshmen and introduced Elite Four members Rika and Hassel to her friends. After Liko and Ann's battle, Nemona appeared again wanting to battle but was interrupted by the ringing of the Academy's bell.
 
In Sparkle! The Glow of Fire and Art!, Nemona was in Artazon again helping with an Art Festival that would be held by Naranja Academy and Brassius: Upon meeting Roy again, Nemona immediately challenged him to a battle which she won without much difficulty, despite Roy and gave their best. After the battle, Nemona took her friends to the workshop where work was being done. After Liko, Roy and Dot showed off their art, Nemona watched Roy's battle against Brassius. Some time later, it was revealed that Nemona took a photo with Liko, Roy and Dot before separating from the group.

In Showdown! The Paldea Elite Four, Nemona reunited with Liko, Roy, and Dot when they returned to Naranja Academy, after explaining their next challenge, Nemona watched the students' battles against Paldea's Elite Four. After Roy's defeat in the battle against Hassel, Nemona came personally to tell him to continue doing his best. In next episode, Nemona watched Liko and Katy's battle against Rika alongside Roy and Ann.

In Resonating Spirits in a Challenge to Ryme!, it was revealed that Nemona traveled to Montenevera, and after saving from falling from the sky, Nemona reunited with Liko, Roy, and Dot again. Soon after, Nemona watched alongside Liko and Dot as Roy battled Ryme, and when Roy was defeated, Nemona joined the girls to see how Roy and Fuecoco were doing. In the following episode, in order to cheer Roy up, Nemona held a Hyper Training with him and Fuecoco. As the afternoon wore on, Nemona joined the group and heard the story of why Roy likes to sing. Later, Nemona watched Roy and Ryme's rematch and after Roy's victory, she congratulated him for advancing another step in the Tera Training.
 and Arven]]
In Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger!, Nemona met with Liko, Roy, and Dot again. After talking about the progress of the Tournament for the Tera Training students, she watched the battles while Liko and Roy solved a problem at Naranja Academy involving the Explorers. In the next episode, Nemona praised Roy and Liko's heroic actions in saving the school from the Explorers, whom she heard from Penny. Soon after, Nemona watched Liko and Roy's battle alongside Penny and Arven, and after Roy's victory, Nemona congratulated him on the result and said she was proud of Roy's progress up to that point alongside Ryme.

In Terastallization vs. Mega Evolution!, Nemona was at Naranja Academy strolling around when she noticed Dendra and her chasing after Ult, believing he was up to no good. Nemona and Dendra caught Ult and his . Eventually, Nemona reunited with Liko, Roy, and Dot, who clarified that Ult was their teammate. Nemona then decided to challenge Roy to a Double Battle, having wanted to battle him again after a long time, which he eagerly accepted, with Nemona's Pawmot and against Roy's Crocalor and . It was an intense battle, with Nemona using various tactics to defend, heal, and attack, but Roy was able to employ clever tactics to overcome these measures. In the climax of the battle, Nemona stallized her Pawmot while Roy Mega Evolved his Lucario, with Lucario emerging victorious. Pawmot's defeat led to Roy being declared the winner. After the battle, Nemona congratulated Roy, while Ult wanted to battle her next. To everyone's surprise, Penny challenged Dot to a battle instead. In the next episode, Nemona analyzed the battle between Penny and Dot. At the end of the day, when saying goodbye to the group, she highlighted how much they have evolved as people and Trainers and that she expects great things from them.

In Welcome to Blueberry Academy!, Nemona returned as a student at Blueberry Academy. She had a Double Battle against Roy, using her Pawmot and to battle Crocalor and Lucario. Using Decidueye's to stop Lucario from moving, Nemona was able to defeat Lucario before defeating Crocalor, winning her the match. After the battle, Nemona returned to Paldea.
 on a Pokémon for the first time]]
In HZ126, Nemona participated in a meeting between Clavell, Geeta, Penny, and the Rising Volt Tacklers regarding the data they collected from the Strong Sphere. After the Strong Sphere was banned at Naranja Academy, Nemona watched the battle between Liko and Dash, where she witnessed the item's destructive potential. Later, after learning about all the events the Rising Volt Tacklers witnessed, Nemona volunteered alongside Penny to fight against the Explorers' plans.

In HZ127, Nemona battled against Roy with her Pawmot against Roy's Lucario once again. After a tough fight, Nemona Terastallized Pawmot while Roy Mega-evolved his Lucario, with both Pokémon clashing attacks with each other. In the end Pawmot dodged Lucario's final attack at the last moment and defeated it with Mach Punch, winning Nemona the battle.

In HZ131, Nemona, along with Penny and Ann, traveled to Levincia to reunite with the Rising Volt Tacklers. Some time later, she joined the others and they watched Roy's battle against Master Mayonnaise. During the battle, Nemona was able to perceive that Roy was out of sync with , which prevented it from Mega Evolving. In the next episode, Nemona traveled with the group to Diana's castle in Galar. During Roy's rematch against Master Mayonnaise, Nemona joined Liko and explained to her about the bond that Roy and his Pokémon had regarding Aura.

In HZ133, Nemona joined in the battle against the Explorers, joining Penny and Dot in battling against Indi and Rubina's and . The trio struggled against their opponents at first due to their use of and , but with Hamber's arrival, they were able to defeat their Pokémon. In the next episode, Nemona and her group meet back up with their friends, where she met Amethio. Nemona and the group then encountered Spinel, Rubina, and Indi.

In HZ135, Nemona and her friends started erasing the Laquium Core, but the Explorers got in the way, even defeating Penny's in the process. However, Nemona and the group became surprised that Coral turned against Spinel and used her , nicknamed Screamypuff, to take Sylveon's place. The group became even more surprised when Chalce and Sidian also turned against Spinel, as they decided to team up with the heroes in order to stop him for good. During the process to remove Laquium, Spinel merged with its Core, casuing it to awaken, much to Nemona and the group's shock. Nemona and the group tried to fight it, but it was too strong. However, they refused to give up and found out that the center of the Laquium Core was its weak point that they needed to hit. In the next episode, Nemona help the group give Roy and Amethio time for their Mega-Evolved Legendary Pokémon to get charged up so they can destroy the Laquium Core's defenses. Nemona then witnesses the Laquium Core being destroyed for good. After the threat with Laquium was over, Nemona returned to Naranja Academy.

===Character===
 
Nemona is a very friendly and kind person, quickly making friends with Liko and Roy. Nemona has a very supportive personality, showing this when she tried to encourage Roy to continue doing his best in battles after being defeated by Hassel.

She also has a huge passion for Pokémon battles, challenging different Trainers as she encounters them on her way to a battle. During the time that Liko and Roy spent at Naranja Academy, Nemona often challenged people to battle, but was always interrupted by something. In addition to this, in Resonating Spirits in a Challenge to Ryme!, Nemona revealed that she enjoys following some events that involve Pokémon battles, which motivated her to travel to Montenevera just to watch the battles that happened at Ryme's show.

As expected from a , Nemona is well respected in the Paldea region, as shown during her first appearance and when Nemona met Dot who was quite embarrassed in Nemona's presence. It is indicated that this recognition of Nemona's abilities extended to other regions, as in Welcome to Blueberry Academy!, it was shown that the students of Blueberry Academy were quite impressed with Nemona. Despite her young age she is shown to be very knowledgeable about various topics in the Pokémon world such as the Terastal phenomenon and Aura. Nemona also has a very strong moral code, developing a strong dislike for the Explorers due to their actions against the Rising Volt Tacklers and Pokémon. This dislike is further exacerbated after witnessing the effects of Laquium on Dash's , causing her and Penny to join the Rising Volt Tacklers in their opposition against Exceed and the Strong Spheres, showing that her compassion extends to Pokémon as well. This is shown again when she calls out Indi and Rubina for using their Pokemon as tools rather than partners.

==Trivia==
In an interview with magazine, Eri Kitamura spoke a little about her vision for Nemona: for her, although Nemona is a veteran , her willingness to battle means that other people do not see her as a mature Trainer. 
When stallizing her Pokémon, Nemona uses the phrase (Japanese: 輝け！輝け！私の最高の宝物！ Shine! Shine! My greatest treasure!).
